Severe Weather Warning for South West, Central, West and South Gippsland, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: HEAVY RAINFALL which may lead to FLASH FLOODING is forecast to develop from early Saturday morning. Six-hourly rainfall totals between 20 and 35 mm are likely, with isolated falls up to 50 mm possible. 24-hour rainfall totals: For the Otways between 50 and 80 mm are likely, with isolated falls up to 150 mm possible about elevated parts. For Gippsland between 40 and 60 mm are likely, with isolated falls up to 110 mm possible about elevated parts. Conditions are expected to ease during Sunday morn

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Central West Slopes and Plains, Riverina
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Griffith, Narrandera and Darlington Point.

warnings.title: Cancellation of Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Northern Country, North East, East Gippsland
warnings.desc: Thunderstorms are no longer severe, however redevelopment of severe thunderstorms for the remainder of the day is still possible. This warning is now cancelled.

warnings.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning for Goldfields, North Interior, South Interior
warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding, large hailstones and damaging winds in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Carnegie and Warburton.
